arcanist.name: Arcanist
arcanist.role: a spellcaster who attacks from a distance and is weak in close combat
arcanist.standingOrder: when healthy stand and fight, when hurt skirmish

vanguard.name: Vanguard
vanguard.role: a front-line defender who holds enemies in place up close
vanguard.standingOrder: close in and keep hitting. hold them on you.  when badly hurt flee to the back

warden.name: Warden
warden.role: a support leader who heals allies and fights from mid range
warden.standingOrder: hold mid range and keep allies healed. when badly hurt stay clear and keep healing

duelist.name: Duelist
duelist.role: a striker who dashes in for melee bursts then slips away
duelist.standingOrder: dash in for a flurry then slip away. keep skirmishing. when badly hurt stay clear and throw
